review_scope: Six complete pipeline orchestration, initialization, report-stage and fixture artifacts.

claims.statement: The builder appends stages in order; defaults run initialization, replay loading, appliance and enterprise scans, organization/repository discovery and scans, evaluation and reporting. Placing replay loading before scan stages expresses a no-live-API replay requirement, which also depends on every scanner skip guard.
